observation.command:
cd /tmp
# Install Composer on the host
curl -fsSL -o composer-setup.php https://getcomposer.org/installer 2>&1 && php -r '' 2>/dev/null; which php php8 php8.4 2>&1
echo "--- php not on host, will use ddev php for a bootstrap ---"
# We have no host php. Check apt availability for php.
apt-cache policy php8.2 php8.1 2>/dev/null | head; echo "==="
ls /usr/bin/php* 2>/dev/null; echo "no host php"
